title: The H&J Tavern and Russell first hearing him
summary: Thomas switched to Boehm clarinet while at the H&J Tavern in World War II; Russell recalls hearing him there in 1943 on George Lewis's advice.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years

blocks.x: Well, I wonder to ask you, when did you switch to this band system, Cullen actually got down?
